name: ripgrep
summary: Line-oriented search tool that recursively searches current directory for a regex pattern
description: ripgrep is a line-oriented search tool that recursively searches your current directory for a regex pattern. Inside Clipak, it executes unconfined across arbitrary host mount points and project hierarchies.

curation.unconfined_reason: Requires unconfined read access across host filesystem trees (/home, /var, /etc, /tmp) to search arbitrary developer codebases
